text:
alex_j: Heads up — last night we got ~10 gpu-eviction pages across non-prod clusters between ~02:30–03:10. Most were transient bursts, not impacting requests. Can we make gpu-eviction ticket-only unless sustained >5m AND grouped by cluster? Paging on every burst is burning oncall.

maya_p: +1. Group by cluster + severity label. Also keep pages for env=prod always. Maybe set `for: 5m`.

chris_r: agree. Draft rule snippet:
```
alert: GPU_EVICTION_BURST
expr: increase(gpu_evictions_total{job="kubelet"}[5m]) > 3
for: 5m
labels:
  severity: ticket
  team: eng-sre
annotations:
  summary: "GPU eviction burst on {{ $labels.cluster }}"
  runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/gpu-evictions
```

sam_s: add: if alert has label `env=prod` -> set `severity=page`. For non-prod -> ticket unless `for` fires. Also add suppression when `upgrade=true` tag present.

lia_w: We should also consider mute windows for weekday nights for non-prod (22:00–06:00) and only page if error rate > SLO threshold. Oncall fatigue is real.

oncall-bot: notice: GPU_EVICTION_BURST fired 8 times in last 24h (clusters: dev-us-west, ci-eu)

alex_j: Good point. Can't rely solely on burst count — tie paging to downstream SLO impact (e.g., pod restarts > X or p99 latency spike). If SLO unaffected, ticket.

maya_p: I'll add a small Grafana panel that computes paging-rate / day + hit threshold alert. That can be used as a guardrail.

chris_r: I'll open a PR to adjust the rule set: change severity labels, add `for: 5m`, group by `cluster`, add `env=prod` override, and add suppress when `upgrade=true`. Will ping for review.

sam_s: runbook snippet we should include in PR:
- check node gpu memory pressure
- check driver logs: `/var/log/nvidia-installer.log`
- check pod OOMs: `kubectl get events -n <ns>`
- if widespread, escalate to infra and set SLO exception

lia_w: can we also add a short metric `pager-ops.rate[24h]` to track pages/day per oncall? would help for operator fatigue dashboards.

alex_j: sounds good. If no objections by EOD I'll land a canary change for non-prod in staging, then roll to prod after 1 week. tagging @eng-sre-oncall for visibility.

maya_p: :thumbsup: thanks — will coordinate the Grafana panel and add a test alert to staging.
